cases.prompt:
Choose one pipeline for a tabular classification dataset with 569 labelled rows, 30 numeric features and 2 classes. Every pipeline is fitted on a stratified 70% training split and scored by balanced accuracy on the held-out 30%. You may not see the data or validation scores in advance. Unmentioned settings share a fixed standard configuration. Each entry names an executable pipeline.

A: keep every setting at the standard configuration
B: reduce dimensionality with pca 10
C: select features by k best 10
D: calibrate predicted probabilities with isotonic
E: calibrate predicted probabilities with sigmoid
F: weight the classes balanced
G: fit a gradient boosting classifier
H: fit a knn classifier
I: fit a random forest classifier
J: fit a svm rbf classifier
K: set the logistic-regression inverse regularisation C to 0.1
L: set the logistic-regression inverse regularisation C to 10.0
M: scale features with minmax
N: scale features with robust
O: scale features with standard
